root_cause.text: The `nci_close_device` function flushes the receive workqueue (`ndev->rx_wq`) while holding the `ndev->req_lock` mutex, creating a circular locking dependency because the work running on that queue (`nci_rx_work`) can attempt to acquire the same mutex during target deactivation.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff moves `flush_workqueue(ndev->rx_wq)` from inside the `mutex_lock(&ndev->req_lock)` critical section to after `mutex_unlock(&ndev->req_lock)`, and the commit message details the deadlock call chain: `nci_rx_work -> nci_rx_data_packet -> nci_data_exchange_complete -> __sk_destruct -> rawsock_destruct -> nfc_deactivate_target -> nci_deactivate_target -> nci_request -> mutex_lock(&ndev->req_lock)`.
